summary: This dataset consists of various objects and files related to brain organoid and retinal organoid experiments, including ATAC, protein, and RNA data, as well as phospho-seq and multiome data. The objects include full_object.rds, rna_object.rds, multiome_object.rds, and retina.rds, which can be imported into Signac/Seurat using specific lines of code. The dataset also includes fragment files and index files for each object, such as fullobject_fragments.tsv.gz and retina_fragments.tsv.gz.
